title: Mission Basilica San Juan Capistrano
geometryBasis: The standing Mission Basilica is named in the surveyed 18-point OpenStreetMap outline at 31520 Camino Capistrano. Its mapped body height is 17.04 m. The facade and tower occupy the northwest end of the footprint, across the forecourt from Camino Capistrano.
sectionBasis: The parish confirms the 1986 completion. The architect’s contemporary description and published architectural survey support the long cross-shaped nave and cupola. Cleared Qualla images establish the white Mission Revival silhouette, ornate facade and two stacked octagonal belfries with terracotta roof.
limitations: The 18-point exterior perimeter, bell tower and principal cupola dominate the reconstruction. Internal room boundaries, roof junctions, masonry ornament and smaller rear roof heights are approximate.
Scope covers the 1986 basilica and adjoining rooms in its mapped footprint. The original ruined Great Stone Church and historic mission buildings are separate sites.
USGS bare-earth data supplies near-site grades. Entry stairs and wall contact are interpreted from the original photographs and elevation field.
